title: Full-Day Toronto Tour with a Local, Custom + Private
includes: Online questionnaire link sent after booking to tailor your experience and match you to a local host

This is a private City Unscripted experience: real people, real connections

After booking, you'll receive a short online questionnaire to share your interests, preferences, and must-sees. Your City Unscripted guide will personally reach out to craft a fully customized itinerary that suits your style—whether you love history, food, hidden gems, or cultural experiences.
This private tour is a walking experience. A private vehicle is not included.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This isn’t a rigid itinerary—it’s a full-day walking experience through Toronto, crafted entirely around what excites you. Whether you’re drawn to design, history, local culture, or food, your host curates a day that keeps the energy up and your curiosity engaged from start to finish.

After booking, you’ll complete a short online questionnaire so we can match you with a local host who understands what you’re looking for. You’ll collaborate to shape a flexible, immersive route—filled with vibrant stops, cultural insights, and moments that reveal the real Toronto beyond the usual tourist trail.
